entries.expected_signal: All tests pass (exit code 0), old/new behavior comparison matches expected compatibility changes
entries.reachability_signal: Exercise both old and new regex matching paths for GRUB_OS_PROBER_SKIP_LIST
entries.input_strategy: Mock grub_probe to return known UUIDs for test devices, then exercise both old (pre-patch) and new (post-patch) GRUB_OS_PROBER_SKIP_LIST matching logic against a matrix of skip list formats (UUID-only, UUID@device, UUID@/dev/sda1, comma-separated, semicolon-separated, space-separated, uppercase, EFI paths, empty list)

contract_probe.before_command: Simulate old matching logic using word-boundary regex and unconditional @suffix appending
contract_probe.after_command: Simulate new matching logic using explicit separator regex and optional @/dev/* suffix
contract_probe.comparison: Compare skip/noskip decisions for identical inputs
contract_probe.oracle: Old: UUID-only entries NEVER match (bug), UUID@device matches. New: UUID-only entries match correctly, UUID@device rejected, UUID@/dev/sda1 accepted with deprecation warning.

entries.limitations: Test uses mocked grub_probe; does not exercise actual grub-mkconfig integration. Coverage of shell script lines is implicit (all changed code paths are exercised by the test matrix).

compatibility_changes_confirmed: UUID@device rejected, UUID@/dev/* accepted with deprecation
